# Synthetic STEP fixture

`box-10x20x30mm.step` is an original rectangular 10 × 20 × 30 mm box generated by `scripts/generate-step-fixture.mjs` using the installed occt-wasm 4.3.1 kernel. No third-party design or user data is included. The fixture verifies the actual STEP Worker, OpenCascade WASM loading, tessellation and project reconstruction.

`scripts/generate-step-assembly-fixtures.mjs` deterministically builds three more repository-owned fixtures from that box without downloading CAD data:

- `colored-nested-assembly.step`: red and blue 10 × 20 × 30 mm parts inside an assembly translated by (100, 200, 300) mm and rotated 90° around Z, plus a repeated red prototype at (0, 0, 100) mm. The nested part placements are (10, 0, 0) and (0, 50, 0) mm.
- `colored-nested-assembly-meters.step`: identical numeric geometry and placements with meter units, so all physical dimensions are 1,000 times the millimeter fixture.
- `unnamed-box.step`: the base box with blank product names and no color.

The generator writes AP214 assembly relationships explicitly. The fixed 4.3.1 public XCAF builder cannot resolve prototype labels or update an authored assembly compound, while its native STEP-to-GLB exporter does preserve these imported relationships. Tests exercise this fixed-version path and do not require upgrading the kernel.
